absent: Locking, concurrency and lifetime rules for fuse device, ring queues, HDLC configuration and IDE task submission.
State machines and error handling for fuse requests, uring register commit fetch, ATA command execution and SMART flows.
Entry point behavior, validation, capability checks and ioctl dispatch beyond numeric codes and structure shapes.
Byte order, packing, alignment and 32 versus 64-bit layout guarantees except for eight byte directory rounding.
Semantics of flags, timers, retry counters and power management transitions named by the headers.

findings.text: Directory record length is rounded up to an eight byte boundary derived from a 64-bit unit. Name displacement for a plain entry is the offset of its trailing name, and total size is that displacement plus stored length namelen after rounding; the extended plus form applies the same rounding to the nested entry name displacement plus its namelen.
Plus directory item pairs lookup result entry_out with embedded directory entry dirent so one record delivers both attributes and naming information.

Inode invalidation identifies its target as ino with signed bounds off and len. Entry invalidation uses parent with namelen and flags. Deletion uses parent and child with namelen plus pad. Store uses nodeid with offset size plus pad. Retrieve uses notify_unique with nodeid offset size plus pad.

Retrieve input keeps live offset and size surrounded by placeholder words dummy1 dummy2 dummy3 dummy4. Prune output reports count with pad and spare. Backing association pairs descriptor fd with flags plus pad.

Device control magic FUSE_DEV_IOC_MAGIC is 229. FUSE_DEV_IOC_CLONE is subcommand 0 returning a 32-bit value. FUSE_DEV_IOC_BACKING_OPEN is subcommand 1 taking a backing map. FUSE_DEV_IOC_BACKING_CLOSE is subcommand 2 taking a 32-bit value. FUSE_DEV_IOC_SYNC_INIT is subcommand 3 with no payload.

Lseek input conveys fh with offset whence plus pad, and its reply returns only offset. Copy input conveys fh_in and off_in with nodeid_out fh_out off_out len and flags, and its reply reports only bytes_copied.
FUSE_SETUPMAPPING_FLAG_WRITE occupies bit zero and FUSE_SETUPMAPPING_FLAG_READ occupies bit one. FUSE_REMOVEMAPPING_MAX_ENTRY equals page size divided by one removal descriptor size.

Setup conveys open handle fh with file displacement foffset plus len flags and window displacement moffset. Removal starts with count followed by moffset plus len pairs. Sync filesystem input carries only pad.
Single context carries size with pad. Aggregate header carries size with nr_secctx. Extension header carries size with type. Group list carries nr_groups followed by trailing groups array.
FUSE_URING_IN_OUT_HEADER_SZ is 128 and FUSE_URING_OP_IN_OUT_SZ is 128. FUSE_URING_ENT_ZERO_COPY occupies bit zero and FUSE_URING_ZERO_COPY occupies bit zero.
Entry state pairs flags with commit_id payload_sz offset and reserved. Request header concatenates fixed areas in_out and op_in with descriptor ring_ent_in_out.

Ring command FUSE_IO_URING_CMD_INVALID is 0, FUSE_IO_URING_CMD_REGISTER is 1 for register and fetch, FUSE_IO_URING_CMD_COMMIT_AND_FETCH is 2 for commit and fetch, FUSE_IO_URING_CMD_ADD_QUEUE is 3, FUSE_IO_URING_CMD_ADD_BUFPOOL is 4.

Submission carries flags with commit_id and qid plus pad, followed by a discriminated payload that is either pool base uaddr with len or slot ent_zero_copy_buf_index. The slot form is valid only for register commands on zero copy queues and is required to be zero otherwise.

Header uses an include guard. GENERIC_HDLC_VERSION is 4. CLOCK_DEFAULT is 0, CLOCK_EXT is 1, CLOCK_INT is 2, CLOCK_TXINT is 3, CLOCK_TXFROMRX is 4. ENCODING_DEFAULT is 0, ENCODING_NRZ is 1, ENCODING_NRZI is 2, ENCODING_FM_MARK is 3, ENCODING_FM_SPACE is 4, ENCODING_MANCHESTER is 5. PARITY_DEFAULT is 0, PARITY_NONE is 1, PARITY_CRC16_PR0 is 2, PARITY_CRC16_PR1 is 3, PARITY_CRC16_PR0_CCITT is 4, PARITY_CRC16_PR1_CCITT is 5, PARITY_CRC32_PR0_CCITT is 6, PARITY_CRC32_PR1_CCITT is 7. LMI_DEFAULT is 0, LMI_NONE is 1, LMI_ANSI is 2, LMI_CCITT is 3, LMI_CISCO is 4.

Synchronous serial holds clock_rate with clock_type and loopback. T1 E1 adds slot_map. Raw HDLC holds encoding with parity. Frame relay holds t391 t392 n391 n392 n393 with lmi and dce flag. PVC creation holds only dlci while PVC info adds master name. Cisco framing holds interval with timeout. X25 HDLC holds dce with modulo window t1 t2 and n2.

Header is protected by an include guard. HDIO_DRIVE_CMD_HDR_SIZE spans four bytes, HDIO_DRIVE_HOB_HDR_SIZE spans eight, HDIO_DRIVE_TASK_HDR_SIZE spans eight. IDE_DRIVE_TASK_NO_DATA is 0, IDE_DRIVE_TASK_INVALID is -1, IDE_DRIVE_TASK_SET_XFER is 1, IDE_DRIVE_TASK_IN is 2, IDE_DRIVE_TASK_OUT is 3, IDE_DRIVE_TASK_RAW_WRITE is 4. IDE_TASKFILE_STD_IN_FLAGS is 0xFE, IDE_HOB_STD_IN_FLAGS is 0x3C, IDE_TASKFILE_STD_OUT_FLAGS is 0xFE, IDE_HOB_STD_OUT_FLAGS is 0x3C.

Register selection uses a sixteen bit union with per register validity bits. Standard bits cover data error_feature sector nsector lcyl hcyl select and status_command. High order bits mirror them with data_hob error_feature_hob sector_hob nsector_hob lcyl_hob hcyl_hob select_hob and control_hob. Task request aggregates io_ports and hob_ports with out_flags in_flags plus data_phase req_cmd out_size and in_size. Ioctl wrapper adds task_request with out_buffer and in_buffer. Command header orders command sector_number feature and sector_count. Task and high order headers order data feature sector_count sector_number low_cylinder high_cylinder device_head with command or control last. Port units use byte task_ioreg_t and word sata_ioreg_t.

Trailing variable data requires caller sizing from counts: groups length follows nr_groups, removal descriptors follow count, and directory iteration must apply rounding before advancing. Several numbers carry two names sharing one value, including reset pair at 0x08, recalibrate pair at 0x10, and feature code 0xDD, so decoding depends on generation or alias awareness.
